module: Node "Timeline Replay" (`duration` behavior). Starts a replay file (`core_replay.loadFile`) at the start of its timeline segment and stops it (`core_replay.stop`) at the end. Input pins: `flow`, `filename` (string), `vehId`. The replays are listed in the editor (`core_replay.getRecordings`).
notes: `C.todo`: prototype node, does not work in all cases.
`init` calls `_setupTimeline(5, 10)`: timeline segment from 5 to 10 (timeline units).
The `vehId` pin is not used in the code.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Load Replays" button and dropdown list to choose a recording.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the replay name and the internal flags.

init.desc: Constructor; configures the timeline (5 to 10) and `replayName`.

onTimelineBegin.desc: Called at the start of the timeline segment; requests the replay start.

onTimelineEnd.desc: Called at the end of the segment; requests the replay stop.

work.desc: Loads the replay (relative path of `filename`) if `startReplay`, or stops it if `stopReplay`.
